
 > extension FOR stabilize bugc circuits with underclocking architecture

1. class
 - `.bus` : override `--anime-on` and `--anime-off` to make Under 60Hz
2. custom tags extension
 - `<bus-init>` : load bugc.js then `<bugc></bugc>` then link the bugc (the bugc.css, by `<link rel="stylesheet" src= "https://xunr3.github.io/bugc_underclock_style.css" fetchpriority="high">`)... yes. this is bus enviroment initializer.
  - about loading BUS : actually, BUS is CSS (except for init feature. also init feature is extension of bus.)
   + the `bus-short-src` ver : non-fetching version css src
   + the `bus-src` ver : web fetching version css src
   + the dependancy of BUS : BUS dependent on bugc ... and bugc is actually framework of `HTML/CSS`... so... **BUS is actually run on bugc framework.**

### why it requires 16.7ms?

16.6 is under 100/6 ms but 16.7 is over 100/6 ms. 16.7ms delay is loose fit in CSS Randering interval

#### the ignorance in 0.1ms ~ 16.6ms delay

if anime delay is `0.1ms~16.6ms`, the Invalidation Bailout can caused. the DOM changes caused by JS by near `0.1ms~16.6ms`, and CSS cannot processes it once(once is 1/60s). so Invalidation Bailout cause "DROP" (bail-out drop Slow-path)... but....

#### when anime delay is over "1/60s"

the Invalidation Bailout system not cause bailout, but Successful Batching (Recalculate Style)...

so that CSS is processing multiple DOM changes in once...

### [https://xunr3.github.io/bugc_underclock_style.css](https://xunr3.github.io/bugc_underclock_style.css)

```css
@import url("https://xunr3.github.io/bugc.css");

@layer usingBugc {
  /* bus : bugc underclock style */

  .bus {
    --anime-on: makeCheck 16.7ms;
    --anime-off: makeUncheck 16.7ms;
  }

  .bus-short-src::after {
    content: "tag : <link rel=\"stylesheet\" src= \"data:text/css;base64,\" fetchpriority=\"high\">" !important;
    font-size: 24px !important;
    color: green !important;
  }
  
  .bus-src::after {
    content: "tag : <link rel=\"stylesheet\" src= \"https://xunr3.github.io/bugc_underclock_style.css\" fetchpriority=\"high\">" !important;
    font-size: 24px !important;
    color: green !important;
  }

  .bus-short-import-src::after {
    content: "src : @import url(\"data:text/css;base64,\");" !important;
    font-size: 24px !important;
    color: green !important;
  }

  .bus-import-src::after {
    content: "src : @import url(\"https://xunr3.github.io/bugc_underclock_style.css\");" !important;
    font-size: 24px !important;
    color: green !important;
  }
}
```

### [https://xunr3.github.io/bus.js](https://xunr3.github.io/bus.js) : actually custom tag extension which for load bus easily (abstract: what actually `<bus-init>` work as == loading bus)

```javascript
async function loadbugc() {
    try {
        const module = await import('https://xunr3.github.io/bugc.js');
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('faild to load bugc.js', error);
    }
}

class BusInit extends HTMLElement {
          static #isFrameworkLoaded = false;
          #break_orderd = true;

          constructor() {
                    super();
                    if (BusInit.#isFrameworkLoaded) {
                              throw new Error("[BusInit Error] <bus-init> component can loaded only once.");
                    }
                    BusInit.#isFrameworkLoaded = true;
                    this.#break_orderd = false;
          }

          connectedCallback() {
                    if (this.#break_orderd) return;
                    loadbugc();
                    this.innerHTML = `
<bugc-init></bugc-init>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://xunr3.github.io/bugc_underclock_style.css" fetchpriority="high">
                    `;
          }
}

customElements.define('bus-init', BusInit);

const bus_webcode = (_ => console.log('<script src="https://xunr3.github.io/bus.js" fetchpriority="high"></script>'));
const bugc_shortcode = (_ => console.log('<script src="" fetchpriority="high"></script>'));
```
